# War Scroll Column 1 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** 1QM (Cave 1), Col. 1 | **Condition:** complete

---

**1:1** For the In[structor, the ru]le of the war. The-beginning of the putting-forth-of-the-hand of the Sons-of-Light against the lot of the Sons-of-Darkness, against the army-of Belial, against the troop of Edom and Moab and the sons-of Ammon,

**1:2** and the army of the dwellers-of Philistia, and against the troops of the Kittim-of Asshur, and with-them the violators-of the covenant — helpers of wickedness.

**1:3** The sons-of Levi and the sons-of Judah and the sons-of Benjamin, the exiles-of the wilderness, shall wage-war against them with [...] against all their troops, when the exiles of the Sons-of-Light return from the Wilderness-of-the-Peoples

**1:4** to encamp in the Wilderness-of Jerusalem. And after the war they shall go-up from there [...] against the Kittim-of Egypt.

**1:5** And in-his-time he shall go-forth with-great wrath to wage-war against the kings-of the north, and his anger shall seek to-destroy and to-cut-off the horn-of

**1:6** [his enemies. This] shall-be a time-of salvation for the people-of God, and an appointed-time of dominion for all the men-of his lot, and of eternal destruction for all the lot-of Belial.

**1:7** And there-shall-be [great] panic among the sons-of Japheth, and Asshur shall fall and there-shall-be none to-help him. And the dominion-of the Kittim shall come-to-an-end, so-that wickedness shall-be brought-low without

**1:8** any remnant, and there-shall-be no survivor of [the Sons]-of-Darkness.

**1:9** And [the Sons]-of-Righteousness shall shine to all the ends-of the world, going-on shining until all the appointed-times-of darkness are-completed. And in the appointed-time-of God, his exalted greatness shall shine

**1:10** for all the time[s of ete]rnity; for peace and blessing, glory and joy, and long-days for all the Sons-of-Light. And on the day the Kittim fall, there-shall-be a battle and fierce-destruction

**1:11** before the God-of Israel, for that shall-be the day appointed by-him from-of-old for the war-of extermination against the Sons-of-Darkness. On-that-day the congregation-of the divine-ones

**1:12** and the assembly-of the men-of [...] shall engage-one-another for great destruction. The Sons-of-Light and the lot-of Darkness shall wage-war together for the might-of God,

**1:13** amid the shouting of a great multitude and the battle-cry of divine-ones and of-men, on the day-of calamity. It-shall-be a time-of tribulation for-all the people redeemed-by God.

**1:14** And of-all their tribulations none shall-be like-this, from its hastening unto eternal redemption. And on the day-of their war against the Kittim, they shall go-forth

**1:15** to-battle. In-three lots the Sons-of-Light shall stand-firm to-strike-down wickedness, and in-three lots the army-of Belial shall strengthen-themselves to-turn-back the lot of [...]

**1:16** [The infantry]-columns shall-melt the-heart, but the might-of God shall strengthen the he[art of the Sons-of-Light.] And in the seventh lot, the great hand-of God shall bring-low

**1:17** [Belial and a]ll the angels-of his dominion and all the men-of [his lot shall suffer eternal destruction.]

---

*EMET notes: Translated from the Hebrew of 1QM (Cave 1, Qumran). Hyphenated compounds preserve Hebrew construct chains and bound morphemes. Lacunae marked with [...] reflect physical damage to the scroll. "Kittim" preserved as sectarian designation (likely Romans). "Sons-of-Light" / "Sons-of-Darkness" are central dualistic terms of the Qumran community. The seven-lot battle structure (lines 15-17) describes three victories for each side before God's decisive intervention in the seventh.*
